title: Prime Minister congratulates Bhawna Choudhary and Pooja Jatyan on winning Silver at the Asian Para Games
body_text: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated Bhawna Choudhary and Pooja Jatyan for winning India’s first-ever medal in Women’s Recurve Doubles at the Asian Para Games, securing a historic Silver. Shri Modi stated that their achievement will inspire many aspiring archers. In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared: "A historic Silver for Bhawna Choudhary and Pooja Jatyan at the Asian Para Games! Congratulations to the duo on winning India’s first-ever medal in Women’s Recurve Doubles at the Games. Their achievement will inspire many aspiring archers: PM @narendramodi" A historic Silver for Bhawna Choudhary and Pooja Jatyan at the Asian Para Games! Congratulations to the duo on winning India’s first-ever medal in Women’s Recurve Doubles at the Games. Their achievement will inspire many aspiring archers: PM @narendramodi — PMO India (@PMOIndia) October 23, 2026 **** MJPS/SS/PRK
